zh.title: 美國空軍RQ-4全球鷹無人機預計將服役至2033年
zh.summary: 美軍因作戰韌性需求及太空能力未成熟，擬延長全球鷹服役至2033年
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，美國空軍可能會將其 RQ-4 全球鷹（Global Hawk）無人機的服役時間延長至 2030 年代。具體而言，美軍預計該型無人機將持續執行飛行任務至 2033 年，以支援各項關鍵的偵察任務。
決定讓 RQ-4 全球鷹無人機繼續服役的主要原因，在於軍方對作戰韌性的需求，以及維持更廣泛的情報、監視與偵察（ISR）能力組合。此外，由於太空領域的相關偵察能力目前尚未發展成熟，該型空中平台在現階段仍顯得不可或缺。

en.title: US Air Force May Keep RQ-4 Global Hawk Flying Until 2033
en.summary: US Air Force plans to continue RQ-4 Global Hawk flights until 2033 to maintain ISR capabilities.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, the United States Air Force may keep its RQ-4 Global Hawk unmanned aircraft flying well into the 2030s. Specifically, the air force expects that the RQ-4 will continue to fly until 2033 to meet ongoing national defense and intelligence requirements.

The extension of the RQ-4 Global Hawk service life is driven by several strategic factors. These include the military's ongoing need for operational resilience, the desire to maintain a wider intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) portfolio, and the fact that space-based capabilities remain relatively immature at this stage.
